[P1] 豆豆食物
撰文/胡妙芬 插画/吴佳臻、陈荃
浙江出版联合集团

[P2] 豆豆食物
撰文/胡妙芬 插画/吴佳臻、陈荃

浙江出版联合集团
浙江少年儿童出版社
2/11

[P3] 我知道
红豆、绿豆、花生、黄豆和毛豆，都是豆科
植物的种子。这些种子含有丰富的蛋白质和
各种营养，常被做成好吃的点心和食物。
小男孩豆豆一家人都喜欢吃豆豆食物，这一天，
豆豆和爷爷奶奶一起吃豆豆点心的时候，竟然听到小
豆豆们吵着要回家。小豆子的家在哪里呢？小男孩豆
豆也好想知道。

[P4] 绿豆和红豆植物长得像
豆豆和妮妮追着红豆、绿豆跑，跑到豆豆田
里一看，到底哪一棵是红豆，哪一棵是绿豆呢？

红豆和绿豆的植物长得真像，都有
绿色的叶子和黄色的小花。啪！剥开豆
荚一看，一个豆豆红，一个豆豆绿，原
来红豆、绿豆还是不一样。

它们长得好像哦，
我都分不清楚了。

剥开豆荚，看豆子颜色，
就知道哪一棵是绿豆，哪
一棵是红豆了。

豆荚是豆科植物的“果实”，
豆子则是果实里的“种子”。
所以，每种豆科植物都会长出
豆荚和豆子。

绿豆豆荚会慢慢变色，当变成紫红色
的时候，就表示豆子成熟了。

[P5] 豆荚就像是豆子温暖的家。豆荚提供养分给豆子，并且保护着豆子，让豆子在豆荚里安全长大。

红豆豆荚裂开，看见红豆。

人们喜欢的各种小点心，常常用红豆和绿豆当作馅料，既营养又好吃。

绿豆椪（pèng）

铜锣烧

绿豆麻薯

红豆麻薯

绿豆糕

红豆面包

每一种豆子都很厉害，变成这么多有营养又好吃的食物。我更喜欢豆豆了！

[P6] 原来花生的家
在地底下。

① 花生开花了。
② 花瓣掉下来，剩下细长的子房。
子房就是“种子生长的婴儿房”。

花生躲在土里
小男孩豆豆追啊追，追丢了花生。
奇怪，花生的家到底在哪里呢？
原来花生开完小黄花以后，会钻进土里，在大家看不见的地方，偷偷长出花生果荚，花生种子就躲在果荚里慢慢长大。

子房

③ 子房变长，带着种子宝宝钻进土里。

Zzz……

讨厌，藏在土
里找不到。

④ 子房里的种子
越长越大，长
成有营养又好吃的花生。
6/11

[P7] 毛豆就是黄豆
毛豆和黄豆要回家，它们跑向了同一个地方，黄豆
和毛豆的植物长得一模一样。
毛豆荚的外面，长满了细细的茸毛，所以
才叫作“毛豆”。这些细毛可以保护毛豆
荚里的豆子，让昆虫不喜欢吃它。
其实，毛豆就是还没完全长大的黄豆，绿色的毛豆继
续留在豆荚里生长，就会长成又黄又硬的黄豆。
毛豆慢慢成熟后，就会变黄、变硬，
摘下来晒干以后就变成“黄豆”了。
原来毛豆和黄豆
是一家人啊。
这么多刺，
会扎破嘴的！
毛豆荚和取
出的毛豆。
算了，不
吃它了。
7/11

[P8] 黄豆加上各种不同的菌种去酿造，就会变成这些不同的食物。
色拉油
黄豆妙用多
黄豆骄傲地说：“我的用处比花生更多呢！”原来，黄豆除了做成食物来吃外，还可以做成豆腐、酱油、味噌和大豆色拉油！豆豆真神奇，变成了各种有营养又好吃的食物。请小朋友也想想看，你吃过哪些豆豆食物呢？
豆皮
原来这些都是黄豆做的！
豆腐
豆浆
豆腐乳
味噌
黄豆芽
开饭了！

[P9] 豆子爱唱歌
杰克魔豆，长高高，
长出豌豆，对太阳微笑。
豆荚打开，豌豆跳跳，
变成音符，快乐弹又跳。
跳进铁罐，嗒、嗒嗒，
溜到玻璃瓶，锵锵锵锵，
滑入纸盒，哗——哗——
躲进塑胶罐，唰、唰、唰，
魔豆跳舞又唱歌，
唱歌跳舞真快乐！
给爸妈的悄悄话
这期的快乐儿歌利用自制乐器——沙铃来伴奏；副歌的地方，则以说唱的方式来演唱。不仅让歌曲听起来充满活力，也可以让小朋友感受不同材质沙铃的音色变化。间奏时，以手摇沙铃的声音为主，让小朋友仔细聆听它们的声音，印象会更深刻。
full_text_en:
[P1] Bean Bean Food
Written by Hu Miaofen, Illustrated by Wu Jiazheng, Chen Qian
Zhejiang Publishing United Group

[P2] Bean Food
Written by Hu Miaofen  Illustrated by Wu Jiazheng, Chen Qing

Zhejiang Publishing United Group
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House
2/11

[P3] I Know
Red beans, mung beans, peanuts, soybeans, and edamame are all seeds of legume plants. These seeds are rich in protein and various nutrients, and are often made into delicious snacks and foods.
The boy DouDou and his family all love eating bean-based foods. One day, while DouDou was eating bean snacks with his grandparents, he suddenly heard the little beans shouting that they wanted to go home. Where is the home of the little beans? The boy DouDou really wanted to know.

[P4] Mung Beans and Red Beans Plants Look Alike
Doudou and Nini chased the red beans and mung beans, running to the bean field. They looked around and wondered, which plant is the red bean, and which is the mung bean?

The plants of red beans and mung beans look very similar, both having green leaves and yellow flowers. Pop! After opening the pods, one bean is red, the other is green. So, red beans and mung beans are still different after all.

They look so similar,
I can't tell them apart.

Open the pod and check the color of the beans,
then you'll know which plant is the mung bean and which is the red bean.

The pod is the 'fruit' of legume plants,
and the beans are the 'seeds' inside the fruit.
Therefore, every legume plant grows pods and beans.

Mung bean pods gradually change color. When they turn purplish-red, it means the beans are ripe.

[P5] The pod is like a warm home for the beans. The pod provides nutrients to the beans and protects them, allowing the beans to grow safely inside.

The red bean pod splits open, revealing red beans.

People enjoy various snacks that often use red beans and mung beans as fillings, which are both nutritious and delicious.

Mung bean cake (pèng)

Dorayaki

Mung bean mochi

Red bean mochi

Mung bean cake

Red bean bread

Each kind of bean is amazing, turning into so many nutritious and delicious foods. I like beans even more now!

[P6] The peanut's home is underground.

① The peanut plant blooms.
② The petals fall off, leaving a long ovary.
The ovary is the "nursery for growing seeds".

Peanuts Hide in the Soil
The little boy DouDou chased and chased, but lost the peanuts.
Strange, where exactly is the peanut's home?
After the peanut plant finishes blooming with small yellow flowers, it burrows into the soil, secretly growing peanut pods in a place no one can see. The peanut seeds grow quietly inside the pods.

Ovary

③ The ovary grows longer, carrying the seed babies into the soil.

Zzz……

Ugh, hiding in the soil,
we can't find it.

④ The seeds inside the ovary
get bigger and bigger,
growing into nutritious and delicious peanuts.
6/11

[P7] Edamame is Soybeans
Edamame and soybeans want to go home; they run to the same place. The plants of soybeans and edamame look exactly the same.
The outside of the edamame pod is covered with fine hairs, which is why it's called "edamame." These fine hairs protect the beans inside the pod and make insects dislike eating them.
Actually, edamame is just soybeans that haven't fully matured. If green edamame stays in the pod and continues to grow, it will become yellow and hard soybeans.
After edamame slowly matures, it turns yellow and hard. Once picked and dried, it becomes "soybeans."
Original: Edamame and soybeans are family!
So many spines, they'll prick my mouth!
Edamame pods and extracted edamame.
Never mind, I won't eat it.
7/11

[P8] Soybeans, when fermented with different types of microbes, can turn into these various foods.
Salad oil
Many Uses of Soybeans
The soybean proudly says, "My uses are even more than peanuts!" Originally, besides being eaten as food, soybeans can also be made into tofu, soy sauce, miso, and soybean salad oil! Beans are truly magical, turning into various nutritious and delicious foods. Please think, little friends, what soybean foods have you eaten?
Tofu skin
These are all made from soybeans!
Tofu
Soy milk
Fermented tofu
Miso
Soybean sprouts
Dinner time!

[P9] Beans Love to Sing
Jack's magic bean, grows tall,
Grows peas, smiles at the sun.
The pod opens, peas jump and jump,
Turn into notes, happily bounce and leap.
Jump into a tin can, tap, tap-tap,
Slide into a glass bottle, clang, clang, clang, clang,
Slide into a cardboard box, splash—splash—
Hide in a plastic can, swish, swish, swish,
The magic bean dances and sings,
Singing and dancing is so much fun!
A Whisper for Parents
This issue's fun children's song uses homemade instruments—shakers—to accompany the music; for the chorus, it's sung in a rhythmic, spoken-word style. This not only makes the song lively, but also allows children to experience the different sound qualities of shakers made from various materials. During the interlude, focus on the sound of hand-shaken shakers, letting children listen carefully to their sounds, making the impression more lasting.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《豆豆食物》的封面，展示了三个孩子围坐在餐桌旁，面前摆放着各种食物，食物被拟人化，画面色彩明亮，充满童趣。
[P2] 本页为绘本《豆豆食物》的扉页，显示了书名、作者和插画师信息，下方配有一个小男孩和两个拟人化食物小车的插图，画面简洁明快。
[P3] 小男孩豆豆和爷爷奶奶一起吃豆豆点心时，发现拟人化的小豆子们吵着要回家，他因此好奇小豆子的家在哪里。页面右上角的知识框介绍了红豆、绿豆、花生、黄豆和毛豆是豆科植物的种子，富含营养。
[P4] 豆豆和妮妮来到豆田，发现红豆和绿豆的植物长得非常相似，难以分辨。通过剥开豆荚观察豆子颜色，他们学会了区分两者，并了解到豆荚是果实，豆子是种子。
[P5] 本页左侧展示了红豆植株和豆荚，解释豆荚是豆子的家并提供保护；右侧展示了多种以红豆和绿豆为馅料的点心，并通过豆豆的对话表达了对豆类食物的喜爱。
[P6] 本页通过图文结合的方式，介绍了花生的生长过程，特别是其子房在开花后钻入土中发育成花生果荚的特性，并通过豆豆的探索和拟人化小虫的对话，生动解释了花生为何‘躲在土里’。
[P7] 本页通过图文结合的方式，解释了毛豆和黄豆的关系，指出毛豆是未成熟的黄豆，两者植株相同，毛豆荚上的茸毛可保护豆子。画面中豆豆感叹毛豆和黄豆是一家人，而拟人化的小虫因豆荚有刺而放弃食用。
[P8] 本页通过图文展示黄豆的多种用途，包括豆腐、酱油、味噌、豆皮、豆浆、豆腐乳、黄豆芽和色拉油，并通过豆豆的对话引导孩子认识黄豆的多样性。
[P9] 本页以儿歌《豆子爱唱歌》为主题，通过拟人化的豌豆在不同容器中发出声音的场景，生动描绘了豆子的快乐与音乐性。右侧的‘给爸妈的悄悄话’为家长提供了使用沙铃等自制乐器伴奏的建议，旨在通过音乐活动增强孩子的听觉体验和参与感。
[P10] 本页展示了一株花生植株的生长状态，画面中可见绿色的茎叶、黄色的小花以及部分子房正钻入土中的过程，直观呈现了花生‘地下结果’的特性。
